name: WdRulerStyle
description: Specifies the way Word adjusts the table when the left indent is changed.

constants.name: wdAdjustNone
constants.description: Adjusts the left edge of row or rows, preserving the width of all columns by shifting them to the left or right. This is the default value.

constants.name: wdAdjustProportional
constants.description: Adjusts the left edge of the first column, preserving the position of the right edge of the table by proportionally adjusting the widths of all the cells in the specified row or rows.

constants.name: wdAdjustFirstColumn
constants.description: Adjusts the left edge of the first column only, preserving the positions of the other columns and the right edge of the table.

constants.name: wdAdjustSameWidth
constants.description: Adjusts the left edge of the first column, preserving the position of the right edge of the table by setting the widths of all the cells in the specified row or rows to the same value.
